ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The upper wire and the lower wire in the circuit in the figure form the same pair of common nodes; the left branch is connected to resistor R1, the middle branch is the power supply electromotive force E in series with internal resistance r, and the right branch is connected to variable resistor RP. Therefore RP is connected in parallel with R1 and the middle branch containing the power supply internal resistance across the same pair of terminals. Reasoning: According to the method given in the problem, equivalent the part other than RP as a Thevenin source. When finding the Thevenin resistance seen looking into the RP port, set the ideal voltage source E to zero as a short circuit, then the middle branch only has r left, so R_th = r || R1 = 1/(1/R1 + 1/r). The problem gives 1/RP < 1/R1 + 1/r, therefore RP > R_th. The load power formula is P_P = V_th^2 RP/(R_th + RP)^2, and its maximum value occurs at RP = R_th. When RP > R_th, gradually decreasing RP will make it approach the maximum power point, so the power obtained by RP increases.

method.method_draft: First identify the circuit topology from the figure: RP is a variable resistor connected across the same two terminals as R1 and the source-with-internal-resistance branch. Treat everything except RP as a Thevenin source. Compute R_th = r || R1. Convert the given inequality 1/RP < 1/R1 + 1/r into RP > R_th. By the load-power formula or maximum power transfer rule, for a load resistance larger than R_th, decreasing the load resistance moves it toward the maximum-power point and therefore increases the power absorbed by RP. Conclude that the power obtained by RP increases.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中电路的上端导线和下端导线形成同一对公共节点，左支路接电阻 R1，中间支路是电源电动势 E 与内阻 r 串联，右支路接可变电阻 RP。因此 RP 与 R1 以及含电源内阻的中间支路并接在同一对端点上。推理：按题设方法，把除 RP 以外的部分等效为戴维南电源。求从 RP 端口看进去的戴维南电阻时，将理想电压源 E 置零为短路，则中间支路只剩 r，所以 R_th = r || R1 = 1/(1/R1 + 1/r)。题给 1/RP < 1/R1 + 1/r，因此 RP > R_th。负载功率公式为 P_P = V_th^2 RP/(R_th + RP)^2，其最大值出现在 RP = R_th。当 RP > R_th 时，逐渐减小 RP 会使它接近最大功率点，所以 RP 获得的功率增大。

method.method_draft: First describe the image as a three-branch two-node circuit: R1 on the left, variable RP on the right, and source E with internal resistance r in the middle. Let V be the voltage across RP and set x = 1/RP. Write KCL at the top node to express V in terms of E, r, R1, and RP; in conductance form, V is proportional to 1/(1/R1 + 1/r + x). Then P_RP = V^2/RP is proportional to x/(A+x)^2, where A = 1/R1 + 1/r. The text gives x < A. Since d[x/(A+x)^2]/dx = (A-x)/(A+x)^3 > 0, increasing x increases P. As RP decreases, x = 1/RP increases, so the power obtained by RP increases.
